content.text: A little lavender, a charming bow, and a coffee bar made just for the occasion. For this beautiful baby shower, we brought a personal touch to our Luxe Coffee Bar with custom Café Bébé signage and matching cup labels, creating a setup that felt right at home among the celebrations.
Take a closer look at how it all came together.

content.text: A little something made just for the occasion
Every celebration has its own personality, and we love finding ways to bring those little details to life.
For Café Bébé, the Luxe Coffee Bar was dressed up with a lavender-striped front panel, delicate bow artwork, and personalised lettering that complemented the shower's theme.
We carried those same details through to the coffee cups with custom labels, adding a sweet finishing touch to every drink served.
Surrounded by greenery, soft lighting, and the lovely details of the baby shower, the Café Bébé Coffee Bar became part of the celebration itself.
From the custom signage to the personalised cups, each detail helped bring the look together while giving guests something special to enjoy.
